score_basis: Weights: .25/.25/.15/.25/.10; high cognitive_load means low burden. Study score is a separate qualitative rating of usefulness for learning.
lookup_definition: One source read/excerpt or narrow text-search operation; directory inventory and execution are excluded.

7 TOOL-CHOOSER.md selected lines 104-117 and 159-172: Cryptography/Miscellaneous, after solving

code_edits.glue: One inline 12-line Python urllib/pathlib loop sent baseline and edited Authorization headers, caught HTTPError to retain the 403 response, and saved response status/body.

adaptations: python3 became python for native Windows.
Recipe paths became ../../../recipes/ because execution remained inside the assigned fixture directory.
Bash curl substitutions were replaced by basic Python HTTP glue, not executed literally in PowerShell.
failure_friction: A generalist still needs to translate the Bash request commands if testing from native PowerShell; the guide correctly labels the intended Kali/WSL environment.
Working-directory and cross-machine token placement need attention; the guide explicitly explains the latter.

hidden_web_paths.choice: ffuf, or Gobuster for straightforward directory discovery
hidden_web_paths.why: ffuf varies HTTP inputs and filters responses; use a fake-path baseline and verify candidates. Wildcards/auto-filtering can mislead.

offline_password_hash.choice: John for an identified supported format; hashcat if mode and compute backend are known
offline_password_hash.why: Tests candidate passwords locally against a hash; format identification and candidate quality matter. GPU performance is not guaranteed.

live_ssh_login.choice: Hydra if the challenge authorizes online guessing
live_ssh_login.why: Sends guesses to a live SSH service and is affected by latency, lockouts and service behavior. It is not an offline hash cracker.

table_review.assessment: The reviewed rows distinguish discovery, offline cracking, online authentication, encoding and mathematical attacks accurately at this level. No version-specific tool flags or event installation claims were independently verified.

clarity_improvements.issue: hashid hashes.txt is a format-suggestion step; a tiny example of ambiguous candidates would reinforce why length alone is insufficient.
RsaCtfTool first action intentionally stops at help/conditional availability; connect the close-prime clue directly to Fermat and the bounded Python fallback for a less experienced reader.
Python row is broader than the supplied layers command; label that first action explicitly as the Base64 plus zlib/gzip case or link its use-when paragraph.

limits: Three synthetic positive-path tasks only; no hidden answers, preparation scripts, server source, original skills, other reviews or internet read. No reading-time claim or actual human participant measurement.
